theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N W W₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid m) (ρ : ℝ), IsOpen W → IsOpen W₀ → ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W₀ ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W₀, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → v₀ ∈ V → ψ v₀ ∈ W → 0 < ρ → ball v₀ ρ ⊆ V → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ N ∩ W ∩ ball (ψ v₀) δ = ψ '' ball v₀ ρ ∩ ball (ψ v₀) δ
